description: This file declares the API for retrieving device information such as serial number, model, hardware version, software version, vendor details, and other device-specific data. It is part of the OSP (OpenSync Platform) Unit API, providing function prototypes for external modules to access device attributes.

methods.name: osp_unit_id_get
methods.description: Returns device identification string, part of AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_serial_get
methods.description: Returns device serial number string, typically derived from MAC address.

methods.name: osp_unit_model_get
methods.description: Returns device model string, may default to CONFIG_TARGET_MODEL.

methods.name: osp_unit_sku_get
methods.description: Returns device SKU string, used for inventory tracking.

methods.name: osp_unit_sw_version_get
methods.description: Returns software version string in specified format.

methods.name: osp_unit_mfg_date_get
methods.description: Returns manufacturing date string in 'YYYY/WW' format.

methods.name: osp_unit_dhcpc_hostname_get
methods.description: Returns hostname string for DHCP client, default format '<SERIAL>_<MODEL>'.

methods.name: osp_unit_sec_schema_is_legacy
methods.description: Indicates if WPA3 security schema is legacy or supported.
